primary: Always capture all3 ranges; all3 receive Fine jobs; normal RAW DMA still uploads only selected H/V, diagnostic mode may upload all3
aux: independent quota and round-robin eligible record; never silently drop approved master timing to service AUX
arbiter: whole-record nonpreemptive round-robin with reserved safety/event channels; source held until final beat handshake
default_unselected_release: after Fine analysis_ref completes/cancels and no diagnostic/replay/upload refs remain; no immediate rearm merely because range was unselected

dma.ownership: FREE -> DRIVER_OWNED -> DMA_ACTIVE -> COMPLETE -> USER_OWNED -> FREE; tail advances only to fully prepared free descriptors
dma.length: driver/BD actual length and header/trailer agree; slot allocation length is not actual record length
dma.b_reader: 128-bit natural-word pipelined reader; target one word/clk_mem; READ_LATENCY_B measured
dma.fine_dma_parallelism: different physical banks may Fine and DMA concurrently; same bank mutually exclusive; jobs nonpreemptive

fifo.note: AXIS FIFO cushions DMA/DDR stalls only; B prefetch FIFO is separate 8-16 word reader-local storage

queue_admission: validate capture samples<=16384 AND record_bytes<=slot_bytes; frozen readiness at window completion, not pulse onset
loss: Finite bursts only under assumed service; no continuous all8 4GB/s promise. DDR storage average must meet retained rate.

fine.hv: independent edge/power/spectral paths within one engine
